_meta.purpose: Test cases that fail for a reason that is NOT a product defect — a case asserting a surface that does not exist, or gated behind config that is off by design. Consumed by scripts/regression/generate-regression-html-report.ts to GROUP AND LABEL such rows, and by triage to pre-classify them.
policy: NEVER a way to silence a real failure. An entry does not delete or hide a row — the report still counts it and prints an explicit 'N excluded as known false positives' disclosure. Pass rates are reported both ways.
Every entry MUST carry `reason` (why it can never pass) and `source` (the memory, ticket, or doc that establishes it). An entry without a verifiable source is not admissible.

The correct long-term fix is to repair or retire the CASE (via /qa-review-tests --fix or a deprecation), not to leave it here. Treat this file as a ledger of known debt, and re-check entries when the underlying surface changes.
Keyed by globally-unique case ID (see .claude/rules/regression.md — case IDs are unique across the whole corpus, enforced by suites:lint), so a caseId is an unambiguous key.

entries.reason: Asserts that a configurable product's configuration survives a Save-for-Later save/restore round-trip. That display behaviour is not implemented in the storefront, so the case is a permanent false red rather than a regression signal.
